parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main enclosure that houses the internal components and washing chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, contains the washing compartment, and ensures water-tight operation during cleaning cycles.
parts.Movement_description: The body itself is stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: The base of the dishwasher is a stainless steel platform that supports the entire structure and houses mechanical and electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the dishwasher, supports internal mechanisms like the motor and pump, and ensures vibration reduction during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The base remains fixed and does not move; it serves as a stable foundation for the appliance.
